description: Supplier verification and Moqway's rating over the last 365 days: an overall 0–100 score and ten dimensions (fulfilment against the factory's own promised ship time, order reliability, product quality, match to listing, packaging, after-sales, repeat buyers, verification, inquiry response measured by Moqway, and transparency: how much the factory has declared). Each dimension has its sample size, confidence and raw metrics, plus a plain-English summary, strengths and watch-outs. Suppliers with fewer than 3 paid orders are labelled 'new'. The breakdown needs a connected buyer account.
name: get_supplier
title: Get supplier profile
